title: Whole Grain Sandwich Crackers with Peanut Butter Filling

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain sandwich crackers with peanut butter filling are crunchy biscuits made from whole wheat grains and layered with a smooth peanut butter spread. They are convenient for a quick snack, lunchbox, or as part of a sandwich.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The crackers are made from whole grains, preserving more fiber and nutrients than refined snacks.
The peanut butter filling is produced without trans‑fats or artificial flavors.
These crackers are popular in school meals because of their handy size and kid‑friendly taste.
Each package typically contains 6–8 servings, making calorie control easy.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Whole grain crackers provide soluble and insoluble fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: The peanut butter filling supplies about 8 g of protein per 100 g, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Peanut butter is high in monounsaturated fats, which can favorably affect cholesterol levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Whole grains deliver thiamine, niacin, and folate, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Magnesium, phosphorus and iron are present, supporting muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Because the product contains peanut butter, it may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with peanut allergy.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: The fat content of the filling makes the crackers relatively calorie‑dense; moderation is advised.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some varieties add salt; people monitoring sodium intake should choose low‑salt options.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the crackers straight from the pack, use them as a base for mini sandwiches, add them to salads, or pair with fresh fruit. For a softer texture, warm briefly in the oven.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. For extended shelf life, keep refrigerated to maintain crispness and prevent fat oxidation.
